method: Local MLX Whisper large-v3-turbo + Silero VAD; Apple Vision accurate OCR for Integra video slides; pypdf for handouts. No ChatCut or cloud transcription used.
limitations: Automatic transcription, not fully human listening-verified. No measured word-error rate.
Second passes use the same ASR model; agreement is a consistency check, not independent accuracy proof.
Quiet dialogue, foreign terms, names and punctuation may still be wrong. Five quiet Integra replies are identified as on-screen-caption supplements.
Timestamps are approximate segment boundaries, not word alignment. Long silent meditation periods are intentional source intervals.
Video OCR uses scene changes sampled at 2 fps. Very short or transitional frames may be missed or partly recognized; images and raw OCR remain in processing.
Speakers are not automatically diarized; dialogue remains in recording order.
Full source claims are preserved; course explanations attribute spiritual and efficacy claims to the authors.
